modelDefaults.reason: Prior model did not expose native Medium/None correctly.

videoOffSubtitleSuppression.reason: Old Core dropped the requested SPU track when sout-video was Off; output completed normally with audio only.

subtitleOnlyClock.reason: Prior MKV consumer had no advancing PCR without selected A/V, and required owned-process deadline cleanup.

longFixtureReplay.reason: Synthetic source was 60 seconds; initial full-output replay exceeded a 30-second deadline. Corrected generators explicitly limit encoding to two seconds; no playback-clock fix was made for this test error.

nativeWindowWrongDefault.reason: QA incorrectly assumed sout-spu defaults Off. Production reflected native On correctly; corrected test exercises both directions.

nativeWindowCheckboxTarget.reason: Generic click targeted the center of a 281px-wide checkbox widget. The successful replay targets its actual indicator at x=6 and verifies visible/enabled state and both actual chains.

buildInterrupted.reason: Owned R1 build was stopped to add the missing MainCtx Q_MOC_INCLUDE; subsequent frozen builds passed.
